One blocker is left, introduced by the fix for round 1's N7. With the POSE root below the repository top, changed-scope selection now ignores every change outside that root.

## Findings

| ID | Severity | Disposition | Location | Defect |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| N1 | medium | blocker | `pose-mcp/internal/cli/validate_scope.go:104` | A changed file at the repository top gives an empty selection and no error. The base engine selected the root and non-self-contained modules (reproduced against both versions). No requirement or decision covers this. |
| N2 | low | follow-up | `pose-mcp/internal/cli/validate_carry.go:251` | `carryExclusions` still compares top-relative names, and two `show <head>:<path>` reads resolve from the top. Carry appears disabled below the top, so this is latent. |
| N3 | low | follow-up | `pose-mcp/internal/cli/validate_index_residuals_test.go:130` | R3, R5, comments and a now-vacuous assertion still refer to a bounded report note that was removed. |
| N4 | low | follow-up | `pose-mcp/internal/cli/validate_index_residuals_test.go:133` | No test fails if the warning drops Git's message, which R2 requires (by reading). |

**Reach of N1:** the shipped CLI always resolves its root to the repository top (`cli.go:440`), so `pose validate` cannot trigger it. It affects callers that pass a lower root, as R1 does. This limit also applies to round 1's N1 and N7, which I did not point out then.
